facts.fact: The ICT minister, Dr Tatenda Mavetera, said Potraz had been in sync with Government in implementing the National Broadband Plan, which Government 'came up with' to provide broadband access at government, business, household and individual levels; the document gives no adoption date or plan period, so as_of is the article's published date.
